dct_description_sm: Also available via Internet from the USGS web site. Address as of 09/09/03: http://water.usgs.gov/pubs/wri/wri934076/; current access available via PURL.
Contributors: Geological Survey (U.S.); Landwehr, Jurate Maciunas.; Lumb, Alan M.; Slack, James Richard, 1944-
Data present as ASCII files; discharge data also present in binary. Several programs require DOS or DOS emulator.
Publication statement: [Reston, Va.] : U.S. Dept. of the Interior, U.S. Geological Survey ; [Denver, Colo. : USGS Distribution Branch], 1993.
Streamflow data from 1659 sites in United States and its territories. Data selected as least affected by human influences.

System requirements: IBM or compatible personal computer; 540kb RAM free; DOS 3.1 or higher; Microsoft MSCDEX 2.1 or later; hard disk with 1 MB free; CD-ROM drive with ISO 9660 driver; UNIX and Macintosh system requirements listed in root directory.
dct_title_s: Hydro-climatic data network (HCDN) streamflow data set, 1874-1988
gbl_displayNote_sm: Based on LOC maps search metadata, including embedded catalog fields. Full item enrichment and collection reconciliation remain pending.
